summary: Iteration 5 (frontend-only): Held Invoice Reprint + Barcode Scan Add — all 6 acceptance scenarios validated via Playwright against the live preview URL. (1) Typing KNOWN barcode '1234567890' into [data-testid=pos-search-input] and pressing Enter adds the existing product to the cart (cart-item-0 appears). (2) Typing UNKNOWN numeric barcode '9999999999913' (13 digits) opens the quick-add dialog with the captured barcode text rendered exactly as entered. (3) Filling quick-add-name='منتج سريع', quick-add-price=15, quick-add-cost=7, quick-add-stock=3 and clicking [data-testid=quick-add-save] closes the dialog, POSTs /api/products (success toast), and the created product appears as a cart item — verified by cart contains 'منتج سريع' and 1 cart-item element. (4a) Clicking Save with empty name shows Arabic error toast 'الاسم والسعر إجباريان' and the dialog stays open — no product created. (4b) Same with name filled but empty sale_price: dialog stays open, error toast shown. (5) Non-numeric string 'foobar' + Enter → quick-add dialog NOT opened; 5-digit numeric '12345' + Enter → also NOT opened (regex /^\d{6,}$/ enforced correctly). (6) Held-invoices dialog: seeded held row shows 'طباعة' button with data-testid=print-held-{id} next to 'استئناف'; clicking it invokes window.open (stubbed) and the produced HTML contains 'طلب معلّق' banner, the shop name ('TEST_it5_shop_…') and the held item name ('منتج تجريبي'). Length of captured HTML: 8423 chars. No backend testing performed (frontend-only iteration).

issues: Radix DialogContent still missing Description / aria-describedby (pre-existing pattern, not blocking) — repeated a11y warnings in console.

critical_code_review_comments: POS.jsx submitQuickAdd validates only name & sale_price but does not sanitize the barcode value — the exact string captured from search is sent as barcode. If a scanner appends a newline or accidentally captures partial name, an invalid barcode could be stored. Consider trimming and re-validating /^\d{6,}$/ inside submitQuickAdd.

printHeld uses setTimeout(printReceipt, 100) but does not await React commit — on slow machines the hidden #held-print-area may still be empty when printReceipt reads innerHTML, producing a blank window. Consider using useEffect on heldPrintPreview to trigger print, or a longer/dynamic wait.

handleBarcodeEnter uses toLowerCase() on the query but barcodes are numeric — noop, harmless. However name match falls back to lowercase comparison; if two products share the same lowercase name, only the first is added — minor UX ambiguity.

After successful quick-add, the code calls addToCart(data) which pushes qty=1 regardless of the quick-add stock quantity entered. If cashier entered stock=3 expecting to sell 3, they must manually change qty. Consider setting qty=+quickAdd.stock (or a separate 'qty in cart' field).

POS.jsx grew again (~607 lines). Iteration 4 already flagged the need to split — quick-add + held-print logic further inflates the file. Split into hooks/components (usePOSCart, HeldInvoicesDialog, QuickAddDialog).

Receipt.jsx isPending branch hides payment_method but still renders 'المبلغ المتوقع' via total which includes tax — if held item had tax_rate>0 the pending slip will include tax without a line. Consider showing subtotal only for pending slips (spec says 'adjusts totals label').

rca of the issue: No issues found. All acceptance criteria for iteration 5 pass.
